claim: Bulgaria halved its education spending between 1991 and 1996

turns.question: Bulgaria halved its education spending between 1991 and 1996
turns.sql: SELECT `year`, `combined_expenditure_share_gdp` FROM `workspace`.`prove_it`.`country_indicators` WHERE `entity` ILIKE '%Bulgaria%' AND `year` IN (1991, 1996) AND `combined_expenditure_share_gdp` IS NOT NULL ORDER BY `year` ASC;
